requirements.title: Vrooli Operational Console Dashboard
requirements.description: System must provide a governed, responsive monitoring dashboard using the vrooli-default / Vrooli Operational Console design system with React. This supersedes the former Matrix-theme requirement by the production-readiness decision dated 2026-08-19: the default system is the platform-supported design contract and is already covered by UI governance.

validation.notes: UI matches the amended vrooli-default design contract
